name: Drya Thornne's lightsaber
description: Drya Thornne's lightsaber was an orange-bladed lightsaber with retractable crossguards. It belonged to Drya Thornne, a lieutenant of the Bedlam Raiders, though it was initially a weapon wielded by an unknown member of the Jedi Order before they were killed and their weapon taken as a trophy by Rayvis, who entrusted several lightsabers in his personal collection to his most trusted lieutenants.

data.name: Drya Thornne's lightsaber
data.destroyed: 9 BBY, Shattered Moon (disassembled by Cal Kestis' and incorporated its crossguard emitter into his own.)
